Evidence: Aldous Huxley ki kitab Brave New World 1932 mein publish hui thi, jo dystopian themes ko explore karti hai (Source 1). Money Heist, jise Netflix par La Casa de Papel ke naam se jaana jaata hai, ek Spanish series hai jo heist genre ko naya roop deti hai aur iski kahani ek son ke apne pita ki maut ka badla lene par kendrit hai (Source 3). Series mein characters ki personal growth aur tragedy ka bhi zikr hai (Source 3).
Justification: Retrieved evidence se yeh pata chalta hai ki Ramesh ka kehna sahi hai ki agar koi Aldous Huxley ki Brave New World padhe aur Money Heist dekhe, toh unhe desh ki samasyaon ka samajh aayega. Huxley ki kitab dystopian themes ko explore karti hai, jabki Money Heist mein characters ki personal struggles aur societal issues ko dikhaya gaya hai, jo dono milkar samajh ko gehra banate hain (Source 1 aur Source 3).
